errors.evidence: The x-axis range starts in the year 2011, not 2012.

errors.text_span: wobei die Einheit „Zufriedenheit“ in Prozentsätzen angegeben ist
errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "Allgemeine Lebenszufriedenheit (im Durchschnitt)". There is no mention of the unit being percentages.
The tick marks on the y-axis are spaced by 0.2 (e.g., 6.0, 6.2, 6.4), not 1.0.

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie stellt die Zufriedenheit der jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen dar
errors.evidence: The light blue line, not the generic 'blue' line, represents this group. The description is ambiguous and proceeds to use data from a different line.
The line for adolescents and young adults (light blue) starts in 2011 at a value of approximately 7.35. The value 6.8 corresponds to the line for adults (dark blue).

errors.text_span: und im Laufe der Zeit bis 2023 einen Wert von etwa 6,3 erreicht, dann bis 2024 auf 6,6 ansteigt.
errors.evidence: The line for adolescents and young adults (light blue) is at approximately 7.4 in 2023 and rises to about 7.6 in 2024. The reported values of 6.3 and 6.6 are incorrect.
The line for adults (dark blue) starts in 2011 at a value of approximately 6.8. The value 7.0 corresponds to the line for seniors (purple).

errors.text_span: und 2023 bei etwa 7,2 erreicht, dann bis 2024 auf etwa 7,0 sinkt.
errors.evidence: The line for adults (dark blue) is at approximately 7.0 in 2023 and rises to about 7.2 in 2024. The description reverses the trend and swaps the values for the years.

errors.text_span: Die rot gefärbte Linie stellt die Zufriedenheit der Senioren dar
errors.evidence: The line representing seniors is purple or maroon, not red ('rot').
The line for seniors (purple) starts in 2011 at a value of approximately 7.0. The value 7.4 corresponds to the line for adolescents and young adults (light blue).

errors.text_span: und zwischen 2013 und 2017 einen Rückgang auf etwa 7,2 erreicht
errors.evidence: The line for seniors (purple) is well below 7.2 in the 2013-2017 period; its values are around 6.8-6.9.

errors.text_span: dann bis 2023 einen Wert von etwa 7,3 erreicht, dann bis 2024 auf 7,6 ansteigt.
errors.evidence: The line for seniors (purple) is at approximately 6.7 in 2023 and 6.85 in 2024. The reported values of 7.3 and 7.6 correspond to the line for adolescents and young adults.
This is a typo; a correct word would be 'erstrecken' or 'betragen'.

errors.evidence: The size of the error bars varies more widely than this range suggests. For example, for adults in 2024, the error bar is approximately ±0.1.
